apps.localizedDescription: Solea plays the live TV, movies and series of the subscription you already have, with a clean interface, dubbed or original versions, profiles, resume and casting to Chromecast. Solea provides, sells and recommends no content and no subscription.

versions.localizedDescription:
## Test version

### Settings
- **Reorganized**: six categories instead of seven (General, Playback, Subscription, Accounts, Advanced, About). Home options (categories, Anime, Sports) are now in General, subtitles in Playback, and technical options in Advanced. A single "Refresh" updates both the subscription and the catalog.

### Subtitles
- **Appearance in detail**: size, weight, colors of the text, outline and background, outline, shadow and height, with "Default values" and "Undo changes".
- **Turn on automatically**: when the audio isn't in your language (Auto), always, only forced subtitles, or never. A choice made on a title still wins.
- **Keyboard**: turn subtitles on or off, and shift them earlier or later by 0.25 s. Subtitles also stay visible in the small player window.

### Jellyfin
- **External address**: add a Tailscale link or a domain name next to your home address. Solea uses the home address when it answers and switches to the external one when you're away.
- **On TV**: a QR code lets you type the server address and your login on your phone instead of the remote.

### Sports and Anime
- **Sports** can be shown as a column on the left, like movie and series categories, or as chips at the top (same setting as the libraries).
- **Anime** is shown as a column until you choose a layout.

## Downloads

- **Android box, Android TV, Fire TV, Android phones and tablets**: `Solea-1.2.5-android.apk`
- **Windows**: `Solea-1.2.5-Setup.exe` (installer) or `Solea-1.2.5-windows.zip` (portable)
- **iPhone, iPad**: with SideStore, see [solea.tv/en/install-iphone](https://solea.tv/en/install-iphone/)

## Test version

### Subtitles
- **Signs in their place**: text that an ASS subtitle places on the picture (labels on a diagram, a shop sign…) now appears where it belongs, smaller, fading in, under the dialogue and in your subtitle style, instead of piling up in a big block in the middle of the screen. New **Signs** setting: in place, at the top, or hidden (also when casting to a Chromecast).
- **ASS subtitles "As in the file"** (Android, new setting): fonts, colors and signs drawn exactly as the subtitle file intends.
- **Picture-based subtitles** (Blu-ray, DVD) are now shown on Android.
- **Italics are kept** (off-screen voices, thoughts), and two new settings hide **opening and ending lyrics** and **hearing-impaired notes**.
- **No more rows of numbers** on screen: vector drawings inside some subtitle files are no longer shown as text.
- Subtitle files in **UTF-16** or **older Windows encodings** are read correctly (apostrophes, accents).

### Casting
- **Jellyfin**: file subtitles are always shown and stay in sync after a long pause; the chosen subtitle track is respected; older Chromecasts that can't play HEVC get a converted video; casting works when your phone reaches the server through a VPN.
- **iPhone**: the volume buttons control the TV only in Solea or when the iPhone is locked; in other apps they control the iPhone again.

### Sports
- **More reliable match listings**: the Sports space now reads public TV guides for your country (and dozens of others, from the US to Brazil, Turkey or the Middle East) before your provider's guide, which is only used as a last resort for the channels the public guides don't know.
- **Event channels**: channels named after a match ("Live | Barcelona vs. Real Madrid") are added to that match, so it shows up even when no regular channel of your country broadcasts it. Those of your country come first. Old event names left over by the provider are ignored.

### Live TV
- **Fewer cuts on overloaded channels**: the player no longer stops after a few cuts when there is no lower quality, it keeps playing.
- **Windows, iPhone**: the player now builds a reserve when a channel starts. The picture comes up faster and cuts are much rarer, in exchange for a delay of up to about a minute behind the live broadcast.

### And also
- **Movies and series after changing subscription**: an empty list from the provider is asked again (automatically every 10 minutes for an hour if needed), and "Refresh" always downloads it again.
- **iPhone**: the home page no longer turns grey when coming back to it.

## Downloads

- **Android box, Android TV, Fire TV, Android phones and tablets**: `Solea-1.2.0-android.apk`
- **Windows**: `Solea-1.2.0-Setup.exe` (installer) or `Solea-1.2.0-windows.zip` (portable)
- **iPhone, iPad**: with SideStore, see [solea.tv/en/install-iphone](https://solea.tv/en/install-iphone/)

## Test version

### Skip intro, recap and credits
- **No more "next episode" at the start of an episode**: some community timestamps place the end credits in the first minutes (Dr. Stone), so skipping the recap or the intro offered the next episode. Credits and previews now only count in the last third of the episode, after the intro, and the next episode is never offered before then.
- **One color per passage on the progress bar**: recap in blue, intro in gold, end credits in coral, preview in purple.

### Profiles
- **Drawn avatars and profile photos**: from the gallery, the camera, a web address, or sent from your phone to the TV with an encrypted QR code. They are kept in your Solea account.
- **Hide categories per profile**, and Movies / Series shown as rows or with categories on the left.

### And also
- **Launch screen**: the Solea logo on a night background, then a rising-sun glow while the app starts, instead of a white screen.
- **French voices** of animated movies and dubbing roles on actors' pages (Wikipedia).
- **Channel previews** are smaller and muted.
- **Smoother gestures**: swipe back and mini player with springs, buttons that press down, long-press vibration, "Reduce motion" respected.
- **Jellyfin casting**: full quality instead of 360p, several addresses per server (domain, home network, Tailscale), file subtitles used directly.
- **Chromecast**: the picture keeps its proportions on every TV.
- Updates are checked when you come back to the app.
- Android build numbers are now readable (101000000 for 1.1.0).

## Downloads

- **Android box, Android TV, Fire TV, Android phones and tablets**: `Solea-1.1.0-android.apk`
- **Windows**: `Solea-1.1.0-Setup.exe` (installer) or `Solea-1.1.0-windows.zip` (portable)
- **iPhone, iPad**: with SideStore, see [solea.tv/en/install-iphone](https://solea.tv/en/install-iphone/)

Thanks to **Brout** for the ideas!

## Solea 1.0

The first final version of Solea. It brings together everything from the test versions 0.9.1 to 0.9.7, plus a lot of work since: a new TV interface, Jellyfin, Trakt and Discord, a Sports space, much better casting, and a safer Solea account.

> **Update required for Solea accounts**: your Solea account now only accepts version 1.0 or newer. Older versions ask you to update. On Android and Windows the update installs from the app; on iPhone and iPad, update with SideStore.

### A new TV interface
- **New home screen**: a large picture of the title you select, "Continue watching" right below, and doors to Live TV, Movies, Series, Anime and Sports.
- **Search, Settings and your profile** are round buttons at the top of the home screen.
- **New search**: channels, series and movies in rows, your recent searches, and movies listed before channels when their title starts with what you typed.
- **Voice search** listens inside Solea and types as you speak, with a mic that pulses with your voice. The remote's search or mic key opens it directly (boxes with a mic remote).
- **Movies, Series and Anime in rows**: New, your Trakt lists, Favorites, Top rated, then every category with "See all".
- **Long-press OK anywhere** for options: favorite, Trakt list, move, guide, replay, remove from "Continue watching".
- **Settings in clear categories** (Subscription, Solea account, Catalog, Services…), each with a short summary.
- **Remote control**: the PIN code pad can be used in full, and ▲ ▼ stay in the Settings page.
- **Create or sign in to a Solea account from the TV** shows the QR code screen: type on your phone instead of the remote.

### Phones and computers
- **Redesigned movie and series pages on phones**: Play right under the title, choices on one sliding line, expandable synopsis.
- **Swipe right to leave a page**, home carousel under your finger, a daily selection from the most popular titles, and the video goes under the camera notch in the player.
- **Computers**: the Play button responds again when the choices take two lines.

### Player
- **Easier to read on bright pictures**: darker shade behind the controls, and play / ±10 s on dark circles on phones.
- **New Audio and subtitles panel**: one line per track with clear labels (VO, forced, SDH, 5.1…), subtitles found online as an "Online" track, and an Appearance panel with a sample subtitle.
- **Forced subtitles in the audio language** turn on by themselves.
- On phones, **a tap hides the controls** without pausing.

### Subtitles
- **More subtitles found online**: when OpenSubtitles has nothing in your language or its daily limit is reached, Solea also looks on SubDL, SubSource and Addic7ed (series). The source is shown when they load.
- **Subtitles made for your exact file** are picked first when they exist.
- **Downloaded subtitles are kept on the device**: watching again doesn't use your daily downloads. Zipped, ASS / SSA and older accented files are read.
- **Sync in one press**: press when you hear the first line and Solea shifts the whole file. Skip a line the author added, go back to the start, or fine-tune by 0.1 s. Your setting is remembered for that file, and it works while casting too, from the remote.

### Live TV
- **Program guide in a grid**: channels by hour, a small live preview of the selected channel, and live or replay in one press.
- **Picture format per channel** (whole picture, fill, 16:9, 4:3), remembered for each channel.
- **Favorite channels in your own order**: long-press OK, then Move. The order follows you to your other devices.
- **Current program, end time and progress** on each channel, taken from the full guide when needed.
- **Smoother motion on Android TV boxes and Fire TV**: the screen switches to 50 Hz for 25/50 fps channels (Settings › Playback).
- **Frozen picture**: Solea notices it even when the sound keeps going, reconnects, tries another format, then a lower quality, and explains when nothing works.

## Test version

### Several subscriptions
- **My subscriptions** (Settings › Subscription): keep several Xtream accounts or M3U playlists and switch between them without typing your details again. Each one keeps its own catalog, and they follow you to your other devices with your Solea account.
- Changing your provider details no longer deletes the previous catalog: the old subscription stays in the list. "Remove" deletes it and its catalog from the device.
- **Options for each subscription**: a name, the User-Agent (only if your provider asks for one), and a backup program guide (XMLTV) used for channels your provider's guide leaves empty.
- Editing a subscription now keeps its backup servers.

### Sports
- **A new Sports door on the TV home screen**: matches and live events for the next two days, taken from your sports channels' guide, grouped by event with the channels showing them. One press to watch.

### Anime
- **Skip intro, recap and credits on more anime episodes**, with a new source used when the usual ones have nothing.

### Backup
- **Backup to a file** (Settings › Solea account): save your subscriptions, profiles, progress, favorites and settings, and restore them on any device. The file contains your passwords: keep it private.

### Trakt
- **Easier sign-in on phones and tablets**: a button opens the Trakt page with the code already filled in.
- **Your Trakt lists in Movies and Series** on phones and computers too, and your personal lists alongside the watchlist.

### And also
- The TV home screen fits five doors, with shorter subtitles.

## Test version

### A new TV interface
- **New home screen**: a large picture of the title you select, "Continue watching" right below, and four doors: Live TV, Movies, Series, Anime.
- **Search, Settings and your profile** are now round buttons at the top of the home screen. The remote's search or mic key opens search directly.
- **New search**: channels, series and movies in rows, with your recent searches.
- **Movies, Series and Anime in rows**: New, My Trakt list, Favorites, Top rated, then every category, with "See all".
- **Long-press OK anywhere** for options: favorite, Trakt list, move, guide, replay, remove from "Continue watching".
- **Settings reorganized** into seven clear categories, each with a short summary.

### Live TV
- **Program guide in a grid**: channels by hour, a small live preview of the selected channel, and replay in one press.
- **Picture format per channel** (whole picture, fill, 16:9, 4:3), remembered for each channel.
- **Smoother motion on Android TV boxes**: the screen switches to 50 Hz for 25/50 fps channels (Settings › Playback).
- **Frozen picture**: Solea reconnects, tries another format, then a lower quality, and explains when nothing works.
- **Favorite channels in your own order**: long-press OK on a channel, then Move.
- Each channel shows the current program, its end time and progress.

### Subscription
- **Backup servers**: add up to 5 other addresses from your provider. If the main one stops responding, Solea switches on its own.

### Trakt
- **Connect your Trakt account** (Settings › Services) with a code on trakt.tv: what you watch is marked as watched, your progress in each series is sent, and your watchlist shows up in Movies and Series. A "Watchlist" button is on each movie and series page.

### And also
- **Voice search** listens inside Solea and types as you speak (Android TV boxes with a mic remote).
- **"Continue watching" on the Android TV home screen**.
- Short announcements can appear at the top of the home screen.
- Casting from an Android box to another TV now works with the remote.

## Downloads

- **Windows**: `Solea-0.9.6-Setup.exe` (installer) or `Solea-0.9.6-windows.zip` (portable)

Questions and feedback: [Discord](https://discord.gg/42FVvupACy). Solea is a player: it provides no content and no subscription.

## Test version

### Connect a TV from your phone
- **Scan the TV's QR code with your phone's camera: Solea opens** and offers to connect the TV in one tap, to your Solea account and your subscription. The TV gets your profiles, progress and favorites. Everything is encrypted for the TV alone.
- On iPhone, the solea.tv/pair page shows an "Open in Solea" button.
- Without Solea on the phone, the solea.tv/pair page works as before.

### Updates from the app (Android)
- **Updating from the app now works**: the download used to stop with an error just before installing.
- If you're on a test version, the next test version is offered without turning on "Beta versions".
- The remote clearly shows which button is selected, and permission to install apps is asked before downloading.
- **One-time step**: versions up to 0.9.4 still have the issue. Install this version by hand once (Downloader or the APK below); after that, updates install from the app.

### Casting
- **Original voices and subtitles (VOST) are kept** when casting to a Solea box or TV, as in the player.
- A short network drop no longer switches a Chromecast to Google's player: Solea's screen is tried again.
- **Settings › About › Detailed log** is much more complete (network, player, casting, conversions), to understand a problem.

## Downloads

- **Android box, Android TV, Fire TV, Android phones and tablets**: `Solea-0.9.5-android.apk`
- **Windows**: `Solea-0.9.5-Setup.exe` (installer) or `Solea-0.9.5-windows.zip` (portable)
- **iPhone, iPad**: with SideStore, see [solea.tv/en/install-iphone](https://solea.tv/en/install-iphone/)

Questions and feedback: [Discord](https://discord.gg/42FVvupACy). Solea is a player: it provides no content and no subscription.

## Test version

### Solea on your Chromecast
- **Solea's own Chromecast screen**: Solea colours, a loading screen with the film's picture, a pause screen with the title, synopsis and time left, and clear messages when a video can't be played.
- **Next episode**: a card with a countdown appears on the TV during the end credits, and the episode starts by itself, keeping the voices and subtitles you chose.
- **Skip intro / recap** from the Solea remote, or automatically if set so in Settings › Playback.
- **Live channels**: channel logo, current and next programme on screen for a few seconds, and Dolby sound converted so it plays.
- **Subtitles from the file itself** when it has them in your language, always in sync; subtitles found online are only used otherwise. They follow your Settings › Subtitles style (size, colour, background).
- **4K TVs and amplifiers**: Dolby sound is sent as is when the TV or amplifier can play it; a 1080p version is picked only when the sound has to be converted.
- **Smoother playback** on modest TVs.

### Casting
- **Pick the TV again to get back in control**: if Solea was closed while casting, choosing the same Chromecast or Solea box brings back the remote for what's playing.
- **AirPlay from iPhone and iPad** to an Apple TV or an AirPlay TV.
- **"Cast to…" shows the kind of device** (Solea box, TV, Chromecast, Google TV) and casting messages are shorter.
- **Only TVs show up as receivers** (box, Fire TV, Android TV, Samsung TV), no longer Android phones.
- **DLNA TVs** (Samsung, LG) get subtitles too.
- **"Keep Solea open"** is shown only when the video goes through this device.

## Downloads

- **Android box, Android TV, Fire TV, Android phones and tablets**: `Solea-0.9.4-android.apk`
- **Windows**: `Solea-0.9.4-Setup.exe` (installer) or `Solea-0.9.4-windows.zip` (portable)
- **iPhone, iPad**: with SideStore, see [solea.tv/en/install-iphone](https://solea.tv/en/install-iphone/)

Questions and feedback: [Discord](https://discord.gg/42FVvupACy). Solea is a player: it provides no content and no subscription.

## Test version

### Lighter Android app
- **New audio decoder** for the sound a box or phone can't play by itself (DTS, TrueHD, Dolby Digital…).
- **The Android app is more than twice as small**: about 38 MB instead of 90 MB.

### Remote control
- **The PIN code pad can be used in full with the remote**: ▼ from the first row no longer gets lost.
- **Settings**: ▲ ▼ stay in the page instead of jumping to a category on the left, and the data sources in About can be read to the bottom.

### Error log
- **Settings › About › Detailed log**: adds diagnostic notes (device discovery…) to the error log, useful when reporting a problem. Off by default, on this device only.

- **iPhone, iPad**: with SideStore, see [solea.tv/en/install-iphone](https://solea.tv/en/install-iphone/)

Questions and feedback: [Discord](https://discord.gg/42FVvupACy). Solea is a player: it provides no content and no subscription.

## Test version

- **Player controls easier to read** on bright pictures: darker shade behind the controls, play and ±10 s on dark circles (phones).
- **Finding your devices**: detailed diagnostic notes in Settings › About › Error log, to understand why an iPhone doesn't find a Solea box or computer. Copy the log and send it on [Discord](https://discord.gg/42FVvupACy).
- Fewer network errors in the log when the iPhone goes to the background.
